notes.title: Pick Me Pick Me Ver. 1.7.0 - Dark Academia Update
notes.notes: [h1]Welcome, dear player, to Dark Academia![/h1][h3]Pick Me Pick Me Version 1.7.0 is here - and with it comes new characters, new scenarios, new skins, and new scenarios to spice up your dates![/h3][p][/p][h1]Esteemed Scholars,[/h1][h3]The scent of old parchment and autumn rain is in the air. A new term has officially begun, and with it comes a wealth of new knowledge, new faces, and new secrets to uncover. We are delighted to announce the release of [b]Pick Me Pick Me - Update 1.7.0: Dark Academia.[/b][/h3][h3]Light your candles, open your books, and prepare for a semester of intellectual pursuits and whispered confessions.[/h3][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]New Curriculum & Arrivals[/b][/h3][p][/p][h3]🧪 [b]New Student: Victor[/b] [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230328/ca6bd0e7ddfba348dd60cb2c9f6ca147f5bf2803.png"][/img][/p][h3]A mysterious new scholar, Victor, now walks these hallowed halls. With a mind as sharp as his wit and a past shrouded in intrigue, he brings with him a collection of all-new scenarios and heart-pounding dates. We invite you to make his acquaintance.[/h3][p][/p][h3]🕯️ [b]Grace's Scholarly Attire[/b] [/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230328/96addb4b64d04036934eadfc6fa1f7a194b5ca9b.png"][/img][/p][p]Grace has found inspiration in classic literature and has donned a new wardrobe to match. Her Dark Academia skin is now available, reflecting an air of refined intellect and timeless elegance.[/p][p][/p][h3]📚 [b]Your Academy Uniform (Limited Time)[/b][/h3][p] To commemorate the new term, a bespoke player uniform, tailored to the Dark Academia aesthetic, has been made available. This attire will only be offered for a limited time, so secure yours from the university tailor before it's archived forever.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Campus Modernization Projects[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3]⚙️ Our groundskeepers have implemented the following improvements for a better student experience:[/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Discord x Pick Me Pick Me Account Linking[/b][/h3][list][*][p][u]Connect to campus directly to the official [/u][url="https://discord.gg/pickmepickme"]Pick Me Pick Me Discord server[/url][u].[/u] [/p][/*][/list][p]By linking your university records [b](your game account)[/b] to your Student Union membership [b](your Discord account)[/b], you will be granted an [b]exclusive title[/b] and access to private discussion halls reserved for our most dedicated scholars. It is the perfect place to debate theories, share your latest discoveries, and consort with fellow students. Look for the new connection portal in your settings.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]A Notice from the Archives:[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]Red-dot notifications will now appear on the "Scene" and character-specific pages, ensuring you are always alerted to newly discovered fragments of story.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]A Word from the Bursar's Office:[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]A clear pop-up notification will now confirm the reimbursement of any spent tickets.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Campus Maintenance Report[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]🐞 The following issues have been addressed and rectified by our maintenance staff:[/p][list][*][p]The "Room Settings" signage, which was previously too verbose in Portuguese, French, and Spanish, has been properly tailored to fit its frame.[/p][/*][*][p]The 'Random Selection' mechanism for choosing a date in the common room has been repaired and is now fully functional.[/p][/*][*][p]Lost property reports of missing item icons in the event shop have been resolved; all icons are now back in their proper place.[/p][/*][*][p]The common room password door now accepts entry via the 'Enter' key, for more convenient access.[/p][/*][*][p]The overlapping notices and pamphlets during campus orientation (the tutorial) have been reorganized.[/p][/*][*][p]The registrar's records have been corrected to accurately display all upcoming rewards and affection progress.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Your dedication to this institution—and this game—is what allows us to continue exploring new chapters. We eagerly await the stories you will write this semester![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Yours in study and secrets, [/p][p][/p][p][b]The Pick Me Pick Me Dev Team[/b] <3[/p]

notes.title: Pick Me Pick Me Ver. 1.6.0 - AI Opponent Update
notes.notes: [h1][b]Update v1.6.0 is here![/b][/h1][h2][b]Meet Celeste & Challenge New AI Opponents![/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Hello everyone![/b][/h3][p][b]We're thrilled to push our latest update, v1.6.0, live for all of you today! [/b][/p][p][b]This patch brings some major new additions to the game that we think you're going to love, including a brand new character and a way to play anytime you want.[/b][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Introducing AI Opponents![/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Ever wanted to warm up before a big match or just learn the ropes without the pressure of a live opponent? Now you can! We've introduced [b]AI Opponents[/b] to the game. This has been a big request from the community, and it's perfect for honing your skills, testing out new strategies, or just getting a quick game in when you're short on time. We'll be keeping an eye on their difficulty and making adjustments based on your feedback![/p][h2][/h2][h2][b]New Character: Celeste Joins the Fray![/b][/h2][p][/p][p]A new challenger has arrived! Please give a warm welcome to [b]Celeste[/b], our newest playable character. We can't wait to see you discover her unique playstyle and master her abilities. [/p][p]Celeste is a stargazing academic who tends to have her nose stuck in a book, and her head in the clouds. We hope you enjoy getting to know her, especially if you're a fan of young ladies with a bookish personality, and charming wit. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230328/4cb6c10887ece95661fb1d292d55365e28beaa20.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]To go along with our new arrival, we've also released a fantastic [b]new skin for Stella[/b]! Head over to the shop to see her new look.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230328/d5f1a45bf1d910950125222128bedf0c18a4cafa.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Earn in-game tickets with Reward Ads![/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We're introducing a new, completely optional way for our mobile players to earn in-game goodies while supporting our development! You'll now see options for rewarded ads in the game, which incentivize our free-to-play users to watch ads to earn in-game tickets/cash![/p][p]We're committed to keeping the core game experience clean, so this is just for those who choose to use it.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Full Patch Notes - v1.6.0 (09-04-2025)[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]For those who love the details, here's the full breakdown of today's update.[/p][p][b]Added[/b][/p][list][*][p]Introduced AI opponents for enhanced gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented ad system with rewarded ads.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new playable character: Celeste.[/p][/*][*][p]Released a new skin for Stella.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Improved[/b][/p][list][*][p]Optimized the shark headgear to correctly bind with character bones. (Your sharks will now behave!)[/p][/*][/list][p]We're incredibly excited for you to get your hands on this update. Thank you, as always, for your continued support and passion for Pick Me Pick Me![/p][p]Please share your feedback on Celeste and the new AI opponents in the forums - we really do read everything![/p][p][/p][p]With lots of love, [/p][p]- The Pick Me Pick Me Dev Team <3[/p]

notes.title: 🚨 Dev Update – Date Ticket & In-Game Currency Update 🚨
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230328/6ef2e2256fa0ae42e283dbd9fd7f9bb1be60e72c.png[/img]
Hey Everyone!

It’s been officially 2 days since launch, and we want to take this moment to say Thank You!!
Thank you for downloading our game, for playing, and hopefully enjoying the funny moments between friends. 

After the past few days, we have listened to player feedback and wanted to help provide a better explanation of the in-game currencies and what they do. 

Any sections with a ⭐next to them will be included in the NEW update!

❤️‍🔥 The Daily Date Ticket.
5 Date Tickets ⭐

We heard you all loud and clear regarding 2 was just not enough to enjoy the dates and our exciting gameplay. So, we have increased the max amount of tickets from 2 to 5, with 1 ticket regenerated every 24 hours, whether you are playing or offline. 

This means every 5 days, you’ll have 5 dates to enjoy with friends. Around 40 minutes of flirting!  You can have one date per day, or save it all for the big battle day with friends. 
*For early players, you will receive 5 date tickets in the mailbox.*

As we are celebrating our Launch, players will be able to get an extra 1 free Date Ticket every day for the next 2 weeks after Launch! Make sure to check out our Featured Creators and Ai2U for further extra bonuses!!


💰 What are the Different Currencies in-game?
CASH 💸

Cash is the currency used after your date tickets have run out, or if you want to talk with characters in Solo Chat.

PVP Battle:  50 Cash =1 Date Ticket
Solo Chat: 5 Cash =1 Message 

COINS 🪙

Coins are the currency used to unlock characters and purchase clothes, hair, and accessories in the store.

How do you earn coins?
(WIN) PvP Game = 1000 Coins
(LOSE) PvP Game = 500 Coins
Solo Chat - when you receive a reply from a character = 50 Coins
Character Affinity Milestone Rewards

DATE TICKETS 🎟️

Date Tickets are used for PvP Battle

1 Date Ticket = 1 PvP game
* If the room setting "It's on me" is selected, then the host will consume 2 tickets instead
*After you run out of date tickets, you will automatically use any available Cash instead.

MONTHLY PASS & VIP STATUS 🔓

A Monthly Pass is a special package available in the store for $9.99. Think of this as purchasing the game for 30 days, with:

- Unlimited PvP games ⭐
- 4500 Cash (never expired)
- Maximum capacity of Date Tickets from 5 to 20

This means unlimited dates within 30 days! One ticket is regenerated every 24 hours, so you can accumulate up to 20 tickets in 20 days. Use these tickets to invite friends to a PVP Battle, or save them for later.

During certain events/collaborations, you could also have more rewards included from new characters to exclusive items!

Speaking of which, did you know Eddie from Ai2U is visiting and is included in the Monthly Card package until June 11th? Now’s the time to snag an exclusive date before she’s gone for good!

Please note that players with VIP status have unlimited PvP games for themselves. If a VIP player chooses the “It’s On Me” option, they will spend a date ticket or 50 Cash on behalf of the other player

CASH + COIN PACKAGES 📦


If you are the type of person who would take care of the date bill or want to play as much as you can with friends without the ticket regeneration wait, then this is where you can find a variety of  options in the store 

Wad of Cash =1000 Cash = $1.99 (20 Dates or 200 Messages)
Big Wad of Cash =2750 Cash = $4.99 (55 Dates or  550 Messages)
Wallet of Cash = 5800 Cash = $9.99 (116 Dates  or 1160 Messages)
Bag of Cash =12000 Cash = $19.99 (240 Dates or 2400 Messages)
Vault of 32000 Cash = $49.99 (640 Dates or 6400 Messages)
(Prices may vary depending on region)

500 Free Daily Coins 

WOW, that’s a lot of dates!!



📝 Response to Reviews on Paying 
As our team continues to grow, we’re always looking for new and exciting ways to enhance our games. The Large Language Models that power our characters’ dynamic conversations with players come with real costs. To support this innovative feature and keep bringing fresh experiences to the game, we’ve introduced this monetization model, so everyone has a chance to try it out. 

After much discussion, we have updated our Currency Guide as shown above to provide transparency and explain our reasoning. We are working on a game workshop where you’ll be able to create your own dateable characters, which will be launching soon.  Our goal is to continue expanding the game with innovative features and unique experiences, ensuring lasting enjoyment for our players while building a vibrant, ever-evolving world. Please keep in mind that we are an indie development team and need to cover staff salaries. We hope you will stick with us as we grow, and we sincerely thank you for your current and continued support ♥️

Stay on the lookout for more Dev updates and Game events!


We’ll see you on the battlefield of love,
 — The Pick Me Pick Me Team ❤️‍🔥

notes.title: Dev Update: Introducing the New Rating & Reward Systems in Pick Me Pick Me!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

New week, new article! Here is a sneak peek into one of the features coming to Pick Me Pick Me: the New Rating & Reward Systems! These systems are designed to add more depth, strategy, and replayability to your matches while giving you meaningful goals and fun rewards to chase.
Let’s us explain what it is about.

[b]🏆 Post-Match Rating System[/b]
After each match, your performance will be evaluated through a clear and intuitive rating system. Whether you're a smooth talker or a strategic mastermind, your skills will now be reflected in your rank.
Winner Ratings:
🥇 SS Rank – Absolute perfection!
🥈 S Rank – Impressive charm and wit.
🥉 A Rank – Solid performance.
👍 B Rank – Well played!
👌 C Rank – Could use a little polish.
Loser Rating:
❌ F Rank – Better luck next time!
These ranks aren’t just for bragging rights—they directly impact your rewards.

[b]🎁 Post-Match Rewards[/b]
What’s a victory without rewards, right? Each match will grant different types of rewards depending on your performance and the character you played with.
1. Dating Story Reward
Available for both Official and Characters created by the community.
Win your match, and you’ll unlock an AI-generated short story based on your conversation. It’s a fun and unique way to relive your best moments!
2. UGC Character Match Rewards
Earn Echos currency after completing matches.
No affection points here—UGC characters play by different rules!
3. Official Character Rewards
Gain Affection Points based on your rating tier.
Tier-specific bonuses pop up at the end of your match.
Every interaction counts, and every reward brings you closer to unlocking even more content.

[b]❤️ Affection System (Official Characters Only)[/b]
Relationships take time, and Pick Me Pick Me reflects that with the Affection System. Build deeper connections with Official Characters and unlock unique content as you grow closer.
Affection Rewards Include:
📜 Character Unlock Rewards: Invitation letters and access to exclusive character options.
🗝️ Character Secrets: Unlock hidden preferences, backstories, conversation hints, and even strategic tips.
💰 Additional Rewards: Coins, outfits, and planned future CG rewards.
Every secret you uncover brings you closer to truly knowing your favorite character.

We can’t wait for you to try the game out. Your feedback will be invaluable in refining these features, so get ready to dive in and share your thoughts!
Stay tuned, and thank you for being part of the Pick Me Pick Me journey. 🥰

The Pick Me Pick Me Team

notes.title: 🛠️ Game Update: Introducing the Character Workshop
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 
Today, we're thrilled to share an exciting behind-the-scenes look at one of the most anticipated features coming to Pick Me Pick Me: the Character Workshop. This system is set to expand the way you play, create, and share your experiences in the game. So, grab your favorite snack, and let's dive in!

🎨 What is the Character Workshop?
The Character Workshop is more than just a feature—it's a playground for creativity. This system allows players to design, share, and interact with custom AI dating partners. Whether you're crafting a quirky romantic lead, a mysterious heartthrob, or a fan of TV shows, the possibilities are endless!
But that's not all. You can also explore a world of characters created by other players, adding layers of variety and unpredictability to your gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230328/1046a65d2af4d97d795ae2c5e93492995369ceb0.png[/img]

🔍 A Quick Look at Character Browsing
Ever wondered what other players are creating? The Browsing Interface will be your gateway to discovering community-made characters. With an intuitive design, you'll be able to browse, preview, and even collect your favorites.
What you'll see:
Character portrait & preview
Name and last modification date
Play count and like statistics
Author's notes
File size and creator details
What you can do:
Download up to 3 characters (10 in the future!)
Like and rate characters
Select characters for gameplay
Preview them before downloading
It’s like exploring a treasure chest filled with vibrant personalities ready to join your adventures!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230328/19974699970364d8925967c7266663043a9ba577.png[/img]

🛠️ Unleash Your Creativity with Character Creation
The Character Creation Tool puts you in the director's seat. You’ll have access to powerful tools to design both the look and personality of your AI character.
Basic Setup:
Upload a VRM format 3D model
Add a portrait (512x512 pixels)
Set essential details: Name, Age, Gender, and a Catchy Tagline

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230328/8a100b34f5c41fc73a9d6d0092731a6fa4fb8960.png[/img]

Personality Customization:
Choose their core personality: Rational, Emotional, or Neutral
Fill in background stories, personality traits, and behavioral logic
Add up to 50 sample responses to guide their unique dialogue style

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230328/2e9d8358f04ef35dfda576dd39c6d638757d1ffc.png[/img]


Advanced Settings:
Author's notes for tips or backstory
Create custom Q&A pairs for surprise interactions
Fine-tune emotional expressions and animations
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230328/bcb6694bdd11c7499085affc5be0675d95eb208c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230328/b6603dd32916dc378b8edf9507496f43379ff029.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230328/96edb88736ef33d1488a99f4c76373573e04013e.png[/img]


Whether you're building a romantic poet, a chaotic prankster, or a stoic philosopher, your character will feel alive and ready to charm (or challenge) players.


❤️ Why Does This Matter?
At its core, the Character Workshop isn’t just about creating cool characters—it’s about fostering a community. Sharing your creations, discovering others, and seeing how your characters thrive in someone else’s game is an experience we can't wait for you to enjoy.
The Workshop bridges creativity and connection, and we're incredibly excited to see how you'll use it!

🚀 What's Next?
Our team is hard at work fine-tuning the Character Workshop, ensuring it's both powerful and easy to use. Your feedback will be invaluable once this feature rolls out, so stay tuned for updates and get ready to dive in!
In the meantime, don’t forget to wishlist Pick Me Pick Me on Steam and join our Discord to stay in the loop.
👉 [url=https://discord.gg/EAUu2mbAsF]Join Our Discord[/url] 👉 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3358190/Pick_Me_Pick_Me/]Wishlist on Steam[/url]
See you soon, and happy creating! 🥰
The Pick Me Pick Me Team
